description: This file contains unit tests for generic grains using Azure Storage backends (Table and Blob) in an Orleans project. It defines test classes with fixtures for setting up the Azure storage environments and includes test methods for verifying grain operations with various storage configurations.

classes.description: Unit test class for generic grains using Azure Table Storage as the persistence provider.
